title: [deployment 03/06] Add the e2e and pi-agent contract CI tiers

labels.name: spec:approved
labels.description: Spec passed /define-behavior audit — ready for the dispatcher to pick up

body:
**Blocked by:** #250, #178

## Context

Last of three parts of the repository-workflow and CI-gate slice of the `deployment` batch (approved behavior in #187). #249 delivered the develop/main CI triggers and the required-check contract; #250 added the `unit`, `integration`, and `dependency-check` tiers. This part completes the gate with the e2e scenarios and the pi-agent contract tests (#134) so that every tier runs on every PR update and every merge to `develop` or `main`. #189 relies on this complete gate when checking tag eligibility for an exact SHA.

## Task

- Add the `e2e` job to `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, running the e2e tier from #114 on every pull-request update and every merge to `develop` or `main`.
- Add the `pi-agent-contract` job, running the pinned pi runtime contract tests from #134 as part of the same workflow — one test suite, not a separate pipeline.
- Add both job names to the required checks of both the `develop` and the `main` branch protection, completing the contract from #249: unit, ephemeral-PostgreSQL integration, e2e, pi-agent contract, and #173 dependency checks all run with stable required names.

## Scope

### In scope

- The `e2e` and `pi-agent-contract` jobs, required-check registration, and necessary documentation.

### Out of scope

- The other three tiers — #250; branch reconciliation and protection — #249.
- Feature-test expansion, retiring `develop` — never (see #187).

## Acceptance criteria

- All five tiers run on every pull-request update and every merge to `develop` or `main`, each reporting under its stable required name.
- A failing `e2e` or `pi-agent-contract` job blocks the pull request from merging; a green run of all five merges through the one gate.
